notes: This registry is the single machine-readable authority for whether ACK2007 model inputs may be constructed from raw data.
It does not replace frozen synthetic compiler fixtures.
R-005 requires FOREIGN_SALES, AUDITOR, INST_CON and LITIGATION to remain SECONDARY_SOURCE until matched to ACK2007 primary evidence.
C1/C2/C3/O3 remain unresolved; no conflicting definition may be selected for execution.

SEGMENTS.reason: Exact fiscal timing must be locked before raw construction.

FOREIGN_SALES.definition: Candidate secondary definition: 1 if firm reports foreign sales; 0 otherwise
FOREIGN_SALES.reason: R-005: the currently recovered definition is supported only by Phase 4 / later JAR 2009 evidence, not ACK2007 primary evidence.

M&A.definition: Merger/acquisition activity indicator as defined by the paper

RESTRUCTURE.definition: Restructuring activity/charge indicator as defined by the paper

RGROWTH.definition: Decile-ranked sales-growth construct; exact ACK2007 window remains under provenance conflict (2001-2003 versus 2002-2004).
RGROWTH.reason: R-002/C1: primary JAE evidence has not resolved the competing windows, ranking population/direction, or missing-data eligibility rule.

SIZE.definition: Market-value-of-equity size construct; exact ACK2007 transformation, unit and averaging window remain under provenance conflict.
SIZE.reason: R-003/C2: primary JAE evidence has not resolved ln(MVE) versus average MVE in USD billions, nor missing-year/sample-eligibility handling.

%LOSS.definition: Candidate secondary definition: proportion of years 2001-2003 with negative earnings
%LOSS.reason: R-004/C3: primary evidence does not establish the missing-year denominator, sample-eligibility rule, or exact earnings item.

RZSCORE.definition: Decile-ranked Altman z-score/distress construct; exact version/formula is unresolved.
RZSCORE.reason: R-007/O3: do not infer Altman 1968 versus 1980; formula inputs, ranking population/direction and missing-data policy remain unresolved.

AUDITOR_RESIGN.reason: Concept is supported by the primary preview, but exact executable timing remains pending.

AUDITOR.definition: Candidate secondary definition: indicator for auditor group/market position as recovered in Phase 4
AUDITOR.reason: R-005: exact coding is supported only by Phase 4 / later JAR 2009 evidence, not ACK2007 primary evidence.

RESTATEMENT.reason: Exact executable window remains pending in active ontology.

INST_CON.definition: Candidate secondary institutional-ownership concentration measure recovered in Phase 4
INST_CON.reason: R-005: exact scaling is supported only by Phase 4 / later JAR 2009 evidence, not ACK2007 primary evidence.

LITIGATION.definition: Candidate secondary litigation-risk industry indicator recovered in Phase 4
LITIGATION.reason: R-005: exact SIC set is supported only by Phase 4 / later JAR 2009 evidence, not ACK2007 primary evidence.
